messages:
Emily (Engineer): quick question 11111 1 we had a group hotel folio at checkout for a recruiting event: one card paid the master bill (rooms + minibar + bar tab + shuttle). how should people submit their incidentals/minibar/bar charges when theres only a single folio?
Noor (Events): this comes up a lot for small meetup checkouts. hotel gave a single itemized folio but many lines are generic ("incidentals"). we split with a spreadsheet usually.
Lian (Finance): policy: we reimburse business-related incidental charges (e.g., shuttle, business WiFi, vendor-hosted meals for the employee) if you can reasonably tie the charge to the employee. preferred: hotel itemized folio with room-by-room breakdown. if the folio is not room-separated, submit: 1) photo/scan of the folio; 2) our "folio-split" spreadsheet with each employee name + amount; 3) manager or event lead signoff.
ExpenseBot: POLICY NOTE  Master folios: upload original folio + allocation sheet. Charges labeled "MINIBAR" or "BAR" are reimbursable only if consumed by the employee during business travel. Shared bottles or vendor-hosted drinks must be annotated (who consumed what).
Emily (Engineer): ok what if minibar was left as a single "room incidentals $45" line and multiple people used the mini fridge?
Lian (Finance): if you cannot get a vendor breakdown, use the folio-split sheet and add short attestation lines per person: "I consumed snacks on 2026-03-10 and claim $15" and event lead signoff. Finance may request additional proof for amounts > $75.
Noor (Events): for bar tabs we collect a quick sign-in at the bar and then reconcile against the itemized drinks list. i'll add that to the event checklist.
Emily (Engineer): does tax/VAT handling change? the folio is in CAD but receipts need USD reimbursement.
Lian (Finance): attach the folio and the card statement showing the charge. we convert using transaction date. VAT where reclaimable will be handled for reimbursable portions only. non-reimbursable personal splits keep VAT personal.
Noor (Events): any naming convention for upload? makes approvals faster.
Lian (Finance): please name attachments like: lastname_1845006789_folio.pdf and lastname_1845006789_folio_split.csv and include manager_ok_1845006789.png.
Emily (Engineer): thanks, i'll fill the spreadsheet and add brief attestations.
Avery (People Ops): i'll add a short template to #docs and share the folio-split sheet in the event playbook. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
